title: Slovakian Oven-Baked Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful Slovakian-inspired dish featuring oven-baked chicken wrapped in a crispy tortilla. Perfect for a quick snack or meal.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with Slovakian-Style Paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the Vegetable Oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the sauerkraut to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until softened.
Warm the tortilla wrap in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
Slice the cooked chicken breast into thin strips.
Assemble the wrap by placing the chicken, sauerkraut, and any desired toppings (such as cilantro or diced onions) onto the tortilla wrap.
